text:
alex_dev: :rotating_light: Alerts firing — cache-proxy returning 502/504s, backend RPS spiked ~6x after the runtime deploy. Lots of fanout from cache misses.

mira_infra: saw it. prefix cache miss rate jumped from ~4% -> ~38% around deploy time.

alex_dev: suspect PR #3421 (prefix-key-normalization v2) that landed ~09:12. Changed how tokenizer whitespace is normalized before hashing.

sam_runtime: logs show many keys that only differ by trailing whitespace/tokenizer variant. Eg:
```
key_before: model=gptx|prefix='Summarize:'|tok_hash=abc123
key_after:  model=gptx|prefix='Summarize:' |tok_hash=def456
```
Misses exploded because normalized forms don't match cached entries.

chen_sre: pattern = N*(miss) where each miss fans out to 5 backend calls (kv-get + model-metadata + quota + auth + telemetry). Backend shards saturating.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-291 (eng-runtime, eng-sre notified)

mira_infra: proposed mitigation: 1) rate-limit/cache-proxy fanout 2) flip feature flag to previous keying 3) emergency warmup for top prefixes.

alex_dev: toggling feature flag now (runtime.key_normalization = off).

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: runtime-service rev a1b2c3 -> a1b2c2. Canary 10%.

sam_runtime: prepping cache-warmup script to prepopulate hot prefixes (batched, with backoff). snippet to run from admin host:
```
for p in hot_prefixes:
  curl -s -X POST https://cache-proxy.internal/prewarm -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"prefix": "'"$p"'"}'
  sleep 0.1
done
```
Will coordinate to avoid hitting backend too hard.

chen_sre: applied temporary fanout throttle on cache-proxy: 100 req/s per shard and collapse duplicate in-flight misses (request coalescing).

julie_pm: customer impact? SLA hits? any dedicated customers affected?

mira_infra: brief spike in 5xx for user-facing generation routes ~7m window. A few Dedicated customers saw increased latency; CS notified. No data loss.

alex_dev: rollback completed and canary promoted. Miss-rate steadily returning to baseline. Keeping feature flag off until we have better tests.

sam_runtime: action items captured: add unit tests for prefix-normalization across tokenizer variants, add e2e for cache-key compatibility, instrument metrics: metric.prefix_key_entropy and metric.cache_miss_fanout.

chen_sre: longer-term: add a circuit-breaker that collapses fanout when backend latency > 200ms or miss-rate > 10% for 30s. Also limit telemetry fanout during incidents.

alex_dev: I'll open a follow-up PR to revert normalization changes and add compatibility shim. Also will write a short runbook entry for emergency warming.

mira_infra: drafting postmortem doc and will include timeline + graphs. tagging @eng-runtime @eng-sre for review.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-291 status -> resolved by rollback + throttles + warmup :white_check_mark:

alex_dev: thanks everyone. small win but we need better canary checks for keying changes. :thumbsup:
